issue.title: Conflict with dependency 'org.mockito:mockito-core'
issue.body:
Have a problem with mockito's depenndencies:

:app:preDebugUnitTestBuild UP-TO-DATE

Conflict with dependency 'org.mockito:mockito-core'. Resolved versions for app (2.0.71-beta) and test app (2.2.11) differ. See http://g.co/androidstudio/app-test-app-conflict for details.

final: {"number": 739, "label": "question", "route": "answer", "related": [737, 706, 196], "evidence": [], "reply": "Thanks for the report. This is an Android Gradle dependency check, not a Mockito runtime failure. The app module and the test module resolve different versions of mockito-core and byte-buddy, and the Android plugin stops the build when they differ. Your app module uses mockito-core 2.0.71-beta with byte-buddy 1.4.3, while the test configuration uses mockito-core 2.2.11 with byte-buddy 1.5.3. The simplest fix is to use the same mockito-core version in both places, then let the byte-buddy version come from that single mockito-core dependency, or pin byte-buddy to one version in both configurations. Try aligning the versions and rerun the build."}
